prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of KURMA. Golden giant tortoise Kurma beneath the sea holding Mandara upon his broad shell, full-body diagonal view.
ANATOMY: ONE enormous GOLDEN tortoise, one head, two eyes, one massive natural tortoise shell, FOUR reptilian legs and one small natural tail. Full tortoise form, no human upper body, fish tail, extra limbs, weapon, crown or glyphs. Golden colour is the documented iconographic alternative. [kurma-c33, kurma-c38, kurma-c43, kurma-c28]
MOMENT: Rise and plant all four legs broadly beneath the descending mountain to hold it up, head extended toward the low near camera, one front foot foreshortened. Composed majestic strength, never a snarling monster. The immense mountain presses visibly into the top of his shell.
POWER: His broad back physically arrests Mount Mandara sinking into the ocean-bottom mud during the churning; weight pushes mud clouds aside and pale ocean water churns overhead. No magic beams, creation aura or invented earth globe. [kurma-c41, kurma-c36, kurma-c39]
SCALE & CAMERA: Full-body diagonal three-quarter side composition from extreme low seabed camera; Kurma fills eighty percent of the frame width, FOUR legs intentionally separated and readable, mountain occupies background upper section, no small turtle.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One warm light source filtered down from the water surface above, bronze caustic illumination on tactile golden shell, deep underwater shadows and physically displaced silt.
SURFACE: rich tactile cloth, fur, scales or stone appropriate to the specified anatomy, wet water surfaces and physical dust only where mentioned.
SETTING: Submerged view at the muddy bottom of the Ocean of Milk, the mountain rises from his back up through the water surface. [kurma-c03, kurma-c41]
MOOD: imposing, overwhelming, awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the source; figure and identifying features instantly legible at 200 pixels; never cute, calm, decorative or an ordinary person or animal.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: ONE square image, premium painterly cinematic illustration with tactile brushwork rather than glossy photoreal fashion rendering; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark, nudity, gore, extra heads, limbs, fingers or duplicated anatomy; no film, game, anime or comic design, no neon outline, generic glow aura, magic ribbons or floating runes. Every effect must belong to the cited deed; environmental lighting is artistic presentation.
